categories.description: Display-only source label: first-party, partner, or community. Topical labels such as ai or bots go in the template's template.json. The CLI ignores them.

path.description: Path to the template's template.json, relative to this index, or to source.github.dir when source is set.

source.description: Read template.json and its modules from another public GitHub repo instead of next to this index. Only entries in neondatabase/registry may set it: neon 9.4.0 and later ignore entries in neondatabase/examples that set it, and older versions never read neondatabase/registry.

repo.description: Repository name. It must be public; the CLI sends no token.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA. Defaults to HEAD, the repo's default branch. Pin a tag or full commit SHA so a push mid-download cannot mix files from two commits.

dir.description: Directory in the repo that path is relative to. Defaults to the repo root.

logo.description: Display-only logo. The CLI never fetches it.

logoDark.description: Display-only logo for dark backgrounds. Listings fall back to logo when it is unset. The CLI never fetches it.

website.description: Display-only partner site. The CLI never fetches it.
